title: Derived open adjunction and unit transport under an isomorphism
statement: Let s:X≅Y be a scheme isomorphism [def-pc-scheme], with chosen derived categories [def-pc-derived-category] on both schemes and all localized open sites in a fixed morphism universe. Let e:D(O_X)≌D(O_Y) be identified after localization with termwise pushforward along s.hom. For every open U of Y, derived exact restriction to s.hom inverse-image U and to U has right adjoints RX and RY, with adjunctions adjX and adjY such that for every K in D(O_Y), adjX.unit at e.inverse.obj K is invertible if and only if adjY.unit at K is invertible. No assertion about geometric properties of e is included.

source.place: Lemma 20.28.1, and mapDerivedCategoryRightDerivedAdjunction (exact-left-adjoint specialization); the unit computation of step 2 of lem-pc-affine-derived-open-transport

proof.text: Use the derived restriction square to obtain eU and its natural comparison.

The underived overFunctor on Y is exact and a left adjoint. Its right adjoint R is additive. Apply the small ringed-site K-injective resolution theorem on the localized site to install the Grothendieck structure and hence K-injective resolutions. The proved source-library mapDerivedCategoryRightDerivedAdjunction, the exact-left-adjoint specialization of the derived adjunction theorem, supplies adjY:overFunctor.mapDerivedCategory⊣R.rightDerivedFunctor.

Compose e.toAdjunction, adjY, and eU.symm.toAdjunction. The restriction square, associators and eU.unitIso identify the left composite with restriction on X; transport the adjunction along this natural isomorphism. Expand the composite unit with Adjunction.comp_unit_app and the changed-left-adjoint unit with ofNatIsoLeft_unit. Cancel all equivalence units and the image of the left comparison, then use that e.inverse reflects isomorphisms. Naturality of adjY.unit along e.counitIso.app K identifies invertibility at e.functor.obj(e.inverse.obj K) with invertibility at K.
